# sanity_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Sanity.io document webhook. Webhooks trigger HTTPS POST requests when documents are created, updated, or deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure a document webhook for frontend revalidation
resource "sanity_webhook" "revalidate" {
  project_id  = sanity_project.example.id
  name        = "Frontend Static Revalidation"
  url         = "https://my-frontend.example.com/api/revalidate"
  dataset     = "production"
  api_version = "v2024-01-01"
  http_method = "POST"
  secret      = "super-secret-hmac-key"

  filter     = "_type == 'post' && !(_id in path('drafts.**'))"
  projection = "{ 'id': _id, 'slug': slug.current }"

  include_drafts   = false
  is_disabled_by_user = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) The Sanity API version used to execute the filter and projection queries (e.g. `v2024-01-01`). Required by Sanity.
- `dataset` (String) The dataset to monitor for events (e.g. `production` or `*` for all).
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the webhook.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Sanity project to configure the webhook for.
- `url` (String) The HTTPS URL destination that receives webhook payloads.

### Optional

- `filter` (String) GROQ filter expression to filter documents (e.g. `_type == "post" && !(_id in path("drafts.**"))`).
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers sent with the webhook delivery requests.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method used for webhook delivery: `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `GET`. Defaults to `POST`.
- `include_all_versions` (Boolean) Whether to trigger the webhook across all document releases.
- `include_drafts` (Boolean) Whether to trigger the webhook on draft document mutations.
- `is_disabled_by_user` (Boolean) Temporarily disables webhook execution without deleting the configuration.
- `projection` (String) GROQ projection expression to shape the payload JSON body.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret used to sign the webhook payload using HMAC-SHA256 (`sanity-webhook-signature` header).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) The unique string identifier of the webhook.
